title: Custom Images Client
description: Companion mod for the Custom Images plugin
body:
A companion mod for the [Custom Images](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/custom-images.53036/) plugin which provides an easy-to-use GUI for placing and scaling custom images. No more trial and error!

## Paste an image URL
![The image upload screen, showing the end of an image URL and a picture of a cat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb2aed76420051ef68aa17d9ccd5b45919b5b2c1_0.webp)

## Adjust the scale
![The image adjustment screen, showing a picture of a cat and a scale slider set to 200%](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14826b33f2f37381f821e613e015a8456c22a599_0.webp)

## And place!
![The now scaled-up cat image place onto a wall](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/13341aee6d98c5f7443b0bf85c1525b6d56b18d1.png)
